intro: A video editor, motion designer and animator specialising in short-form video production, editorial media and premium visual storytelling, always eager to develop new skills.
bio:
Hello, I'm Pruthiv, or "divnfx". I've been video editing and practising creative media for 3 years now.

I'm a freelance video editor and producer. I design, edit, animate and produce videos. I really enjoy working on short-form projects like talking-head videos, motion graphics and editorial content, but I'm happy to work on any type of video project. I love the problem-solving side of editing and turning a client's ideas into engaging creative visuals.

In my spare time, you can find me benching some weights, playing games or practising new creative techniques.
